ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) Chrome credential harvesting via GPO-pushed logon script
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's domain-wide Chrome credential theft — a PowerShell/batch logon script mass-deployed through a Group Policy Object (gpscript.exe) that scrapes saved browser logins from every machine the user signs into. Sophos observed Qilin deploying an 'IPScanner.ps1'/'logon.bat' GPO that copied Chrome 'Login Data' across the estate before encryption.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="gpscript.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process, "(?i)(login data|\\\\user data\\\\|chrome|ipscanner|web data|sqlite|password)")
| `ctime(firstTime)` | `ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe"          // process launched by a GPO logon/logoff script
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","User Data","Chrome","IPScanner","Web Data","sqlite")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe"          // GPO-driven logon/logoff script host
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data","User Data","Chrome","IPScanner","Web Data","sqlite")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin Chrome Credential Harvesting via GPO Logon Script
id: 8d3a1f6e-2c4b-4a7e-9f1d-qilinchrome01
status: experimental
description: PowerShell or cmd launched by gpscript.exe referencing Chrome credential stores, consistent with Qilin/Agenda domain-wide browser credential theft.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_chrome:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'User Data'
      - 'IPScanner'
      - 'Web Data'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_chrome
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise logon scripts that interact with browser profiles (rare)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1037.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\gpscript.exe OR *\GPScript.exe OR *\GPSCRIPT.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe) (@CommandLine:*Login\ Data* OR @CommandLine:*User\ Data* OR @CommandLine:*IPScanner* OR @CommandLine:*Chrome* OR @CommandLine:*chrome*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption Safe-Mode reboot chained with recovery inhibition
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin/Agenda signature pre-ransom chain: configuring a Safe-Mode boot (bcdedit /set safeboot) to strip EDR, combined with shadow-copy/backup-catalog destruction on the same host within a tight window — the staging Qilin performs immediately before dropping its Rust/Go encryptor and T1486 data encryption.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as proc_names min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval safeboot=if(match(cmds,"(?i)set\s+\{?\w*\}?\s*safeboot"),1,0)
| eval recovery=if(match(cmds,"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|delete\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\s+no|win32_shadowcopy)"),1,0)
| where safeboot=1 AND recovery=1
| `ctime(firstTime)` | `ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user cmds count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and Cmd has "safeboot")
    or (FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
        and Cmd has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","win32_shadowcopy","recoveryenabled no"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize
    Markers = make_set(case(Cmd has "safeboot", "safe-mode-boot",
                            Cmd has_any("shadow","catalog","recoveryenabled"), "recovery-inhibit",
                            "other")),
    Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 12),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName
| where Markers has "safe-mode-boot" and Markers has "recovery-inhibit"   // both legs = Qilin staging
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and Cmd has "safeboot")
    or (NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe")
        and Cmd has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","win32_shadowcopy","recoveryenabled no"))
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize
    Markers = make_set(case(Cmd has "safeboot", "safe-mode-boot",
                            Cmd has_any("shadow","catalog","recoveryenabled"), "recovery-inhibit",
                            "other")),
    Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 12),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer
| where Markers has "safe-mode-boot" and Markers has "recovery-inhibit"
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin Safe-Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 4b9e7c20-1a8f-4d6c-bb33-qilinsafeboot1
status: experimental
description: bcdedit configuring a Safe-Mode boot, used by Qilin/Agenda (and other ransomware) to reboot into Safe Mode and strip EDR before encryption.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Rare legitimate recovery / driver-troubleshooting workflows by administrators
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1529
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe) (@CommandLine:*safeboot* OR @CommandLine:*delete\ shadows* OR @CommandLine:*shadowcopy\ delete* OR @CommandLine:*delete\ catalog* OR @CommandLine:*recoveryenabled\ no* OR @CommandLine:*Win32_ShadowCopy* OR @CommandLine:*win32_shadowcopy*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(bcdedit|vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin|powershell)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(safeboot|delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no|win32_shadowcopy)", field=CommandLine)
| safeboot := if(regex("(?i)safeboot", field=CommandLine), then="1", else="0")
| recovery := if(regex("(?i)(delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no|win32_shadowcopy)", field=CommandLine), then="1", else="0")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[max(safeboot, as=hasSafeboot), max(recovery, as=hasRecovery), collect([CommandLine])])
| hasSafeboot=1 AND hasRecovery=1
